about: Limits per metric; a profile key (emulator/device) overrides max/min for that device class. run.sh picks the profile from ro.hardware.

unit_tests_failed.about: JVM unit tests of app, ssh-core, desktop-core, terminal-emulator, terminal-view

cold_start_p50_ms.about: am start -W TotalTime, median of 6 cold starts

host_save_with_detection_ms.about: 保存 → fingerprint trust → system + plugin detection done

host_probe_latency_ms.about: card's DNS + TCP latency to the loopback fixture

tmux_reattach_ms.about: 重新连接 tap → tmux session reattached

files_open_ms.about: 查看文件 → home listing shown

plugin_detect_ms.about: 安装插件 sheet → tmux/mosh detected

ssh_connect_p50_ms.about: SSH login to shell, median of 5

echo_p50_ms.about: key commit → echoed on screen, median of 40

scroll_frames_drawn.about: frames drawn while dragging through scrollback (0 = the drag never redraws)

flood_seq200k_main_cpu_ms.about: main-thread CPU parsing and drawing seq 1 200000 at the real frame rate

flood_seq200k_frame_p90_ms.about: 90th percentile frame time while seq 1 200000 is drawn

flood_color_main_cpu_ms.about: main-thread CPU parsing and drawing 20,000 SGR-coloured lines at the real frame rate

flood_color_frame_p90_ms.about: 90th percentile frame time while the coloured lines are drawn

idle_home_cpu_ms_per_10s.about: process CPU over 10 s on an idle home page

idle_home_frames_per_10s.about: frames drawn by an idle home page

idle_terminal_cpu_ms_per_10s.about: process CPU over 10 s on an idle terminal

idle_terminal_frames_per_10s.about: frames drawn by an idle terminal

leaked_sessions.about: closed sessions still reachable after GC

retained_ended_sessions.about: naturally ended sessions still reachable after their cards are removed and GC runs

retained_failed_sessions.about: failed logins still reachable after their cards are removed and GC runs

sftp_download_mbps.about: 16 MiB SFTP download over adb reverse

sftp_upload_mbps.about: 16 MiB SFTP upload over adb reverse

hostlist_frame_p90_ms.about: 90th percentile frame time flinging the host list

desktop_install_first_frame_ms.about: desktop button tap to first frame, plugin and OpenH264 installed from nothing (plan: ≤ 15 s)

desktop_resume_first_frame_ms.about: back into a desktop kept in the background to a new frame (plan: ≤ 1 s)

desktop_static_frames_3s.about: frames a still desktop sends in 3 s after its refine frame (plan: none)

desktop_udp_roam_ms.about: network change on UDP (new socket) to the next frame (plan: ≤ 1 s)

desktop_udp_lost_frames.about: video messages lost outright over UDP with 5% loss each way

desktop_udp_fallback_ms.about: UDP blocked to the picture running over SSH (3 s silence plus a stats tick)

desktop_audio_backlog_ms.about: host sound waiting to be heard on the phone, worst of 10 samples after it settled; the drop line is the jitter target + 120 (E2eAudioTest)

desktop_audio_dropped.about: sound packets dropped to catch up over 3 s of steady playback (E2eAudioTest)
